instruction.text: Select a thing to hear a description of what it’s made of, then drag it to the correct material below.

atoms.sound: This frying pan is made of a material that can hold heat very well.
These scissors are made of a material that has been sharpened to cut.
This book is made of a material that is great for printing pictures on.
These pages are made of a material that words can be written on.

atoms.sound: This dog can look out the window because it can see through the material it is made of.
This fish tank is made of a material that lets you see the fish inside.
This toy is made of a material that is easy to make into many different shapes and colours.
These black bags and colourful containers are all made of the same thin and light material.

atoms.sound: These flower pots are made of a material that was baked in a hot oven.
These strong bricks were made of clay before being baked.
This soft and comfy material is perfect for making blankets.
After washing your hands, you can use this material to dry them.
This pencil is made of a material that is easy to shape with tools.
This chessboard and its small pieces are both made from the same strong material.
